summary: Discovery-First Pivot: adds a proactive small-cap universe that is independent from Top Gainers / Unusual Volume / Most Active, and adds an in-page Early Discovery Radar that can surface market-stage Discovery/Ignition candidates before Sharia verification while keeping Executive recommendations strictly fail-closed to Sharia VERIFIED + Actionability A/B. This separates market discovery from execution eligibility, exposes why recommendations are zero when the compliance feed is missing, and stops treating a blank Executive panel as proof that no opportunities exist. No threshold or score retune; Final Snapshot Reconciliation remains mandatory for training truth.
